info.description: Chat-based personal finance tracker powered by OpenAI.
info.title: Finance Chat API

get.description: Returns comprehensive analytics for the given month. Defaults to current month.

parameters.description: Month to analyse (YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-06). Defaults to current month.
parameters.name: month

get.description: Computes a real, data-derived behavioral snapshot — archetype, consistency/impulse-control/volatility labels, save rate, dominant category, impulse frequency, luxury drift, and top brands — entirely from real transactions. Not month-scoped; uses trailing 30/60-day windows like the existing behavior profiler.
get.summary: Get the user's behavioral spending DNA

post.description: Explicitly invokes OpenAI using the calculated analytics for the selected month. This endpoint consumes AI tokens; GET /api/analytics does not.

parameters.description: Month to analyse (YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-06). Defaults to current month.
parameters.name: month

get.description: Returns just the total expense for each of the last `months` calendar months ending at `month`. Lightweight alternative to calling GET /api/analytics once per month.

parameters.description: Last month in the trend (YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-06). Defaults to current month.
parameters.name: month

parameters.description: Number of trailing months to include (1-24). Defaults to 6.
parameters.name: months

post.description: Waits for the full LLM response, runs the agent pipeline, and returns the result with transaction, behavior DNA, alerts, and recommendations.

Streams LLM tokens as Server-Sent Events. Each token is sent as `event: token`.
When the model finishes, the pipeline result (transaction + behavior DNA + alerts + recommendations) is sent as `event: done` with JSON body.
On error, `event: error` is sent and the stream closes.
post.summary: Parse a natural language message (SSE streaming)

get.description: Returns all manual corrections made by the user. These corrections are used to train the AI.

delete.description: Remove a correction by its ID. This will stop the AI from learning from this example.

get.description: Returns the user's current quest batch with progress evaluated live from real transactions, plus game profile (level/XP) and streak. Quests are auto-completed and XP is awarded idempotently as soon as their progress condition is met.
get.summary: Get the user's current quest board

post.description: Picks a new random batch of quest templates. Rejected with 400 if the current batch still has an incomplete quest.
post.summary: Request a new set of quests

get.description: Returns total income, total expense, and current balance.
Returns all saved income and expense transactions, newest first.
Returns transactions filtered by category and optional month, sorted by most recent first.

parameters.description: Month filter YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-06). Defaults to all months.
parameters.name: month

get.description: Returns a single transaction by ID with full details.

delete.description: Remove a transaction by its ID.

patch.description: User can fix category, sub_category, brand or behavior_tag. Corrections are saved and fed back to the AI on future requests.

parameters.description: Fields to correct (only non-empty fields are applied)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns all wallets for the user, including the implicit General wallet.

post.description: Creates a new occasion wallet for the user.

get.description: Returns the wallet currently selected for new transactions.

patch.description: Sets which wallet new transactions should be attributed to.

delete.description: Archives the wallet (or removes it, depending on its state) for the user.

post.description: Receives events from Line and replies with AI-parsed transaction info. Always returns 200.
